justification: Simple assignment of user-supplied integer value with no obvious memory safety issues
analysis: The function reads from clinfo->priority which is part of the target info structure passed in par->targinfo. This structure is user-supplied through netlink attributes during rule configuration, making the priority value attacker-influenced. The function performs no validation or bounds checking on this value before assigning it to skb->priority. There are no memory allocations, deallocations, or complex indexing operations involved.
